name: Duchess (proposed name)

notes: Half of the rich couple (S2). Cream legs. Costume in engine/page/costumes-everyday.js `duchess`. Skin, iris, cheeks and gloves as Spud's. In S2 she stands at (0.45, 0, -0.30) facing +20 with two shopbags (#f29bb5 in the right hand, #f2c75a in the left), laughing at her husband, never looking at Spud.
